inputs.question: 比较 G-Retriever 与 LPKG 的参数高效训练设计：各自冻结了哪些模块、微调了哪些参数或模型？G-Retriever 当前的检索组件有何局限，LPKG 在错误分析中又指出哪一环影响最大？

outputs.expected_answer: G-Retriever 在 soft prompt tuning 中冻结 LLM 权重 θ 仅训练软提示 Pe（另有 LoRA 微调配置），局限是当前检索组件静态不可训练；LPKG 解耦规划与 QA，仅对规划 LLM（CodeQwen1.5-7B-Chat、Llama3-8B-Instruct）做 LoRA 微调而固定 QA LLM（GPT-3.5），错例分析显示检索模型错误影响最大。

source_references.answer_point: G-Retriever 在 soft prompt tuning 中冻结 LLM 参数 θ、仅通过反向传播更新软提示参数 Pe（另设 Tuned LLM 用 LoRA 微调 Llama2-7b）；其局限在于当前检索组件是静态不可训练的（static retrieval component）。
source_references.title: G-Retriever: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Understanding and Question Answering

source_references.answer_point: LPKG 将规划与 QA 解耦：仅用 KG 规划数据对规划 LLM（CodeQwen1.5-7B-Chat、Llama3-8B-Instruct）做 LoRA 微调，固定 QA LLM（GPT-3.5）以消除 QA 能力差异；40 条错例分析表明检索模型错误影响最大。

source_evidence.text:
Soft prompt tuning eliminates the need for manual prompt design. Given a series of p tokens
X = {x1, x2, . . . , xp}, after being processed by the text embedder, it forms a matrix Xe ∈Rp×dl,
where dl is the dimension of the embedding space. Soft prompts can be represented as parameters
Pe ∈Rq×dl, where q is the length of the prompt. The prompt is then concatenated with the embedded
input, forming a single matrix [Pe; Xe] ∈R(q+p)×dl. This combined matrix is processed by the
self-attention layers in LLM as usual. Training involves maximizing the likelihood of Y through
backpropagation, with gradient updates applied solely to Pe, while θ remains fixed.
4
Proposed GraphQA Benchmark
Our GraphQA represents a comprehensive and diverse benchmark for graph question-answering. It
is tailored to assess the capabilities of models in answering a wide range of questions about graphs
across diverse domains.
4.1
Data Format
Each entry in the GraphQA benchmark consists of a textual graph, a question related to the graph,
and one or more corresponding answers, as illustrated in Figure 2.

Experiments
6.1
Experiment Setup
In the indexing step, we use SentenceBert [34] as the LM to encode all node and edge attributes. In
the generation step, we use the open-source Llama2-7b [42] as the LLM and Graph Transformer [37]
as the graph encoder. Additional details are provided in Appendix B.1.
6.2
Main Results
In our experiments, we consider three model configurations: 1) Inference-only: Using a frozen LLM
for direct question answering; 2) Frozen LLM w/ prompt tuning (PT): Keeping the parameters of the
LLM frozen and adapting only the prompt; 3) Tuned LLM: Fine-tuning the LLM with LoRA [10].
We provide more details in Appendix B.2.
Table 3: Performance comparison across ExplaGraphs, SceneGraphs, and WebQSP datasets for
different configurations, including Inference-only, Frozen LLM with prompt tuning (PT), and Tuned
LLM settings. Mean scores and standard deviations (mean ± std) are presented. The first best result
for each task is highlighted in bold and the second best result is highlighted with an underline.

source_evidence.text:
Conclusion
In this work, we introduce a new GraphQA benchmark for real-world graph question answering and
present G-Retriever, an architecture adept at complex and creative queries. Experimental results show
that G-Retriever surpasses baselines in textual graph tasks across multiple domains, scales effectively
with larger graph sizes, and demonstrates resistance to hallucination.
9

Limitations and Future Work: Currently, G-Retriever employs a static retrieval component. Future
developments could investigate more sophisticated RAG where the retrieval is trainable.

In our framework: (1) For pattern grounding,
we use Wikidata15k as KG, which contains about
15k entities and 263 relations.
The extraction
tool in grounding is modified from existing works
(Ren and Leskovec, 2020). (2) For the planning
LLM Mp, we choose CodeQwen1.5-7B-Chat and
Llama3-8B-Instruct, one excels at coding while
the other excels at common sense reasoning. We
fine-tune them with Lora tuning, running on 4x80G
A100 GPUs for about 3 hours. The fine-tuning is
conducted for 2 epochs, with a learning rate of
5e-5 and a cosine learning rate scheduler. (3) For
retrieval, following previous works (Shao et al.,
2023; Asai et al., 2023), we employ Wikipedia as
the corpus for document retrieval and use the off-
the-shelf Contriever-MS as the retriever. We select
the Top 5 documents as the retrieved information.
(4) For QA LLM, since we only care about the abil-
ity of the planning LLMs, in order to eliminate the
impact of differences in the ability of QA LLMs,
we use GPT-3.5 to align with baselines.

Error Analysis
To gain a deeper understanding
of the model’s performance, we conduct an error
analysis of LPKG. Specifically, we extract 40 in-
correct samples (10 per dataset) of LPKG(Llama3)
and manually categorize the error cases into three
types: planning error, retrieval error, and QA LLM
error. As shown in Table 5, the performance of the
retrieval model has the greatest impact. Among the
13 samples with planning errors, 10 of them are due
to incorrect judgment of the type of questions, and
3 are due to incorrect expression of sub-questions.
Future exploration directions can be based on im-
proving the performance of the retriever model and
enhancing the planning LLM’s ability to identify
question types.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对方法归属、实体角色、实验设置与方向；未见题集须独立人工/代理语义判读。
relation_review.uncertainty: 反例题必须直接纠正错误前提或拒答越界实体，不得迎合题干伪前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
